comment: Second picture is the 18x18 stripboard layout (the first is the schematic). Single populated board with two 8-pin ICs, a Vactrol and a 10K trimmer. The legend names only IC1, and its diode numbers (D1-D2, D3) do not match the board's (D2, D3, D4).
uncertain: Diodes: board shows D2 and D3 drawn as red signal diodes and D4 as a black power diode; legend says D1-D2 1N4148, D3 1N5817. Read by body style (D2, D3 = 1N4148; D4 = 1N5817), the legend numbering looks off by one
IC2: no part number in the legend (only IC1: LF353N); may be meant as a second LF353N
rows: drawn as a signal diode; legend numbering offset
drawn as a power diode; legend calls it D3
